shell: bash -o pipefail -c 'gzip -n -9 -c input.txt input.txt input.txt input.txt input.txt input.txt input.txt input.txt | cksum'
set --; n=0; while [ "$n" -lt 90 ]; do set -- "$@" input.gz; n=$((n + 1)); done; gzip -t "$@" && printf 'gzip stream verified\n'
set --; n=0; while [ "$n" -lt 96 ]; do set -- "$@" input.txt; n=$((n + 1)); done; grep -F -i -w -h -c -e needle -e row= -e group= "$@"
set --; n=0; while [ "$n" -lt 128 ]; do set -- "$@" input.txt; n=$((n + 1)); done; grep -E -h -c '^row=[0-9]{7} group=(07|13|42) (needle|otherxx) [[:alnum:]]+$' "$@"
set --; n=0; while [ "$n" -lt 9 ]; do set -- "$@" input.txt; n=$((n + 1)); done; sort --parallel=1 -S 96M -u -t ' ' -k2,2 -k3,3 -k1,1 "$@"
set --; n=0; while [ "$n" -lt 112 ]; do set -- "$@" input.txt; n=$((n + 1)); done; sha256sum "$@"
